{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=November 2025}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year = 2025–26 |team = SMU Mustangs |sport = Basketball |image = SMU Wordmark Logo.png |image_size = 150 |conference = Atlantic Coast Conference |division = |short_conf = ACC |record = 20–14 |conf_record = 8–10 | CoachRank = | APRank = |head_coach = [[Andy Enfield]] |hc_year = 2nd |assoc_coach = [[Chris Capko]] |asst_coach1 = Jay Morris |asst_coach2 = [[Dana Ford]] |asst_coach3 = Eric Mobley |asst_coach4 = Kurt Karis |stadium = [[Moody Coliseum]] |tourney = [[2026 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = First Four |champion = }} {{2025–26 ACC men's basketball standings}} The '''2025–26 SMU Mustangs men's basketball team''' represented [[Southern Methodist University]] during the [[2025–26 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Mustangs, led by second-year head coach [[Andy Enfield]], played their home games at [[Moody Coliseum]] on their campus in [[University Park, Texas]]{{efn|University Park and its neighbor of [[Highland Park, Texas|Highland Park]] form an enclave within [[Dallas]] known as the [[Park Cities, Texas|Park Cities]]. All locations within the Park Cities have a Dallas mailing address.}} as second-year members of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]] (ACC). The Mustangs began their season with an eight-game winning streak. However, only the final game of the streak, an [[Overtime (sports)#Basketball|overtime]] loss to [[2025–26 Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball team|Mississippi State]] by six-points, was against a Power-4 team. Their streak was broken with a loss to seventeenth-ranked [[2025–26 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team|Vanderbilt]] in the [[ACC–SEC Challenge]]. The Mustangs rebounded with a thirteen-point victory, in overtime, against [[2025–26 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team|Texas A&M]]. They played a fourth SEC team in a row, losing to [[2025–26 LSU Tigers men's basketball team|LSU]] in the Compete 4 Cause Classic. They finished their non-conference slate with wins against [[2025–26 Central Arkansas Bears basketball team|Central Arkansas]] and [[2025–26 Cal State Fullerton Titans men's basketball team|Cal State Fullerton]]. They began the ACC season with an upset of then twelfth-ranked [[2025–26 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]] 97–83. The win saw the Mustangs enter the [[2025–26 NCAA Division I men's basketball rankings|AP poll]] at twenty-fourth. A four-point loss to [[2025–26 Clemson Tigers men's basketball team|Clemson]] and a seven-point loss to sixth-ranked [[2025–26 Duke Blue Devils men's basketball team|Duke]] saw the Mustangs fall back out of the poll. The team went 3–2 over their next five games, losing to sixteenth-ranked [[2025–26 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball team|Virginia]] and twentieth-ranked [[2025–26 Louisville Cardinals men's basketball team|Louisville]] over the stretch. The team went 4–2 over their next six games, with both of their losses over the stretch coming by just one point. They defeated the only ranked team they faced, twenty-first ranked Louisville. They could not carry the momentum through to the end of the season, as they lost four straight games to finish regular season play. They lost by eight-points to the only ranked team they faced in the run, twenty-second ranked [[2025–26 Miami Hurricanes men's basketball team|Miami]]. The Mustangs finished the season 20–14 and 8–10 in [[2025–26 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in a tie for eleventh place. As the eleventh seed in the [[2026 ACC men's basketball tournament|2026 ACC tournament]], they defeated [[2025–26 Syracuse Orange men's basketball team|Syracuse]] in the First Round and faced Louisville for the third time this season in the Second Round. After splitting the regular season series, they were defeated by the sixth-seed and twenty-fourth ranked Cardinals 58–62. Received an at-large bid to the [[2026 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]]. They were an eleven-seed in the [[2026 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament#Midwest regional – Chicago, Illinois|Midwest regional]] and were placed in the [[2026 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament#First Four – Dayton, Ohio|First Four]]. They lost to fellow eleven-seed [[2025–26 Miami RedHawks men's basketball team|Miami (OH)]] by ten points to end their season. ==Previous season== The Mustangs finished the [[2024–25 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|season]] 24–11 and 13–7 in [[2024–25 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|ACC play]] to finish in a three-way tie for fourth place. As the sixth seed in the [[2025 ACC men's basketball tournament|2025 ACC tournament]], they earned a bye into the Second Round, where they defeated fourteenth seed Syracuse for the second time in eight days. They advanced to the Quarterfinals, where they lost to third seed and tenth ranked Clemson, 57–54. They were [[2025 National Invitation Tournament#Exempt qualifiers|exempt qualifiers]] in the [[2025 National Invitation Tournament|NIT]]. The Mustangs were the one-seed in their Dallas Region. They defeated [[2024–25 Northern Iowa Panthers men's basketball team|Northern Iowa]] in the First Round before losing to fourth seed [[2024–25 Oklahoma State Cowboys basketball team|Oklahoma State]]
